rows.reason: transitionSession switches on the closed SessionEvent union (session-availability.ts:158-176, switch :581-602) and handles all nine kinds (:582-599); every caller passes a typed literal (session-lifecycle.ts:357, :557, :966, :1158, :1315; claim-service.ts:1193; query-execution.ts:641-642, :1608; session-health.ts:107; execution-entry-service.ts:909; session-directory.ts:341). No stored or decoded event is fed to it, so the default arm at :600-601 cannot be taken. The row only surfaced because T deleted the legacy case (before session-availability.ts:614-615, TP-135) and the after-T arm index 9 moved to the default; before-T arm 9 was the legacy case body and the default was never executed (no test casts an unknown event; before test line 194 only sends the legacy kind). Nothing here was a test of reachable behaviour, so the class is D2, not N: the arm is runtime code whose state the type guarantees cannot arise.
rows.proposal: Delete the default arm at :600-601. The switch already covers every SessionEvent kind, so TypeScript still rejects a newly added kind at compile time, and the runtime throw for a type-violating value adds nothing. No test belongs anywhere.

rows.reason: provenanceOf (:423-433) asks materialOwnerFromOrigin (:431-432), which for a 'run' origin returns null only when the owner aggregateType is neither Run nor QueryRun (applicability.ts:96-101), i.e. a TaskAttemptRef. The codec still accepts that shape on both the stored-row and put paths (body-codec.ts:152-162; MaterialOrigin in body-ports.ts:7-9), so a body row written by an older writer or a foreign/tampered store is decoded and reaches the null arm. No current writer emits it: every put in src passes a Run/QueryRun or platform origin (create-platform.ts:1999; execution-preparation.ts:180, :573; query-preparation.ts:370; architecture-service.ts:1169, :1180; material-service.ts:151-153). Therefore only reading a stored record in a shape no platform writer produces today reaches the arm: that is U. Claude's D2 premise is wrong because the codec explicitly permits TaskAttempt owners; its own citation body-codec.ts:160-161 shows the acceptance.
rows.proposal: Delete the old-format acceptance: remove TaskAttemptRef from MaterialOrigin (body-ports.ts:7-9) and its branch in normalizeOrigin (body-codec.ts:160-162), so such rows decode as corrupt; decision 79 rebuilds old development stores. materialOwnerFromOrigin then never returns null for a run origin, and the null arm at :432 plus the provenance/owner null checks at :497-499 and :506-507 go. If the shape is instead kept as a boundary rejection for foreign rows, keep it untested (AGENTS rule 4: no tamper test).

rows.reason: if (provenance === null) at :497-499 fires only when provenanceOf returns null, and provenanceOf returns null only through the owner===null arm at :432 (platform_operation returns early at :424-430). Only an old-format or foreign stored record reaches it, so U, not D2.
rows.proposal: Delete together with A1-031: narrow MaterialOrigin/body codec to Run/QueryRun owners; the null-provenance check at :497-499 then has no reachable state and goes. If the boundary rejection is kept for a foreign row, keep it untested (AGENTS rule 4).
